table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	CIC=CAST( i.customicode AS INT),
	PNP= ic.Name,
	DESC1 = i.name,
	PACKK=max(i.packingdesc),
	TP = Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	TPRAT = Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	NRVRT = Round(i.purprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	openb = SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	TTRec = SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END),
	TTSTK = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.ICode = I.ICode), 0),
	GSale = SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END),
	SaleR = SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END),
	NSale = SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END),
	NSVal = SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN (qty + bonus) WHEN type='SR' THEN -(qty + bonus) ELSE 0 END * Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2)),
	NBons= SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	ExpBR = 0.00,
	CLSTK = SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) + 
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END) -
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END) +
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END) + 
		(SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) - 
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) - 
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) + 
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='AI' THEN qty WHEN type='AD' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END)),
	FDate = :ar_startdate,
	TDate = :ar_enddate,
	Other  = SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) - 
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) - 
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) + 
		SUM(CASE WHEN type='AI' THEN qty WHEN type='AD' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END)
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = sum(qty), bonus = 0, value=0
	FROM	(select	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
														when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
														when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
														else looseqty + bonusqty end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
	      pl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	pd.icode,
		qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
	      pl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	d.icode,
		qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate < :ar_startdate
	Group By d.icode) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(looseqty + packqty * packunits),
		bonus = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			when 2 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			else bonusqty
			end, 0)),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			else looseqty + bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		bonus = - sum(bonusqty),
		value = - sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
	      pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate >= :ar_startdate and h.duesatisfydate <= :ar_enddate
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = 0, bonus = 0, value=0 FROM ITEM) St, 
	Item i, 
	itemcategory ic
WHERE st.icode = i.icode and
		i.icatcode in (:ar_icatcode) and 
		i.icatcode = ic.icatcode
GROUP BY I.ICode, St.icode, i.name, i.customicode, i.icatcode, ic.Name, i.saleprice, i.purprice, i.packunits
ORDER BY ic.name, i.icatcode, i.name, i.customicode, St.icode
